An Acknowledgment - Anxiety, my Tumultuous Friend

22 Feb 2025
#Thoughts #Written Word
Table of Contents

I acknowledge you, oh one who’s urge keeps my senses sharp. The one that burns my idle being into action. You who keeps me alive in the face of danger.

I acknowledge you

Strict I must be however. With you who holds so much power over me. I will not suffer your extremities such that they may be my downfall.
